description: The final year of high school carries the group from the river accident into pregnancy, college decisions and the Ravens' pursuit of a state championship. Nathan's financial desperation creates a dangerous debt, Peyton faces a threatening impostor, and Lucas closes in on the truth about Keith as graduation approaches.

s04e01.description: The river accident leaves Nathan, Rachel and Cooper in danger while Brooke ends things with Lucas, Peyton makes a startling discovery and Dan fears exposure.

s04e02.description: The group deals with the accident's aftermath as Brooke turns eighteen, Lucas and Karen face pregnancy news and Deb's addiction again destabilizes the family.

s04e03.description: Lucas and Brooke navigate their breakup, Haley recognizes Rachel's pursuit of Nathan, Peyton meets her half-brother and Skills joins the Ravens.

s04e04.description: Pregnancy rumors spread through Tree Hill while Nathan's post-crash choices worry Haley, Lucas distrusts Derek and Deb undermines Karen.

s04e05.description: Lucas realizes Derek poses a danger to Peyton, while Nathan considers Duke, Rachel meddles in Brooke's dating life and Deb attempts to confront her addiction.

s04e06.description: Nathan's financial problems draw him toward Dan and Daunte, Lucas returns to basketball, Peyton begins rebuilding her confidence and Brooke tests a new relationship.

s04e07.description: Brooke stages a fashion show, Rachel's magazine cover disrupts school and Lucas discovers Nathan's dealings with Daunte while Derek pushes Peyton to face her fears.

s04e08.description: Peyton considers taking a chance on Lucas as Brooke revisits their relationship, while Daunte tightens his hold on Nathan and Rachel turns to Haley for help.

s04e09.description: The Ravens reach the state championship under enormous pressure as Peyton declares her feelings, Haley learns her baby's sex and Nathan's debt to Daunte threatens everything.

s04e10.description: Lucas's medical crisis brings a vision of Keith while Haley and her unborn child fight for survival and Nathan confronts the consequences of his deal with Daunte.

s04e11.description: Lucas returns to school and Peyton, Haley learns the truth about her accident, Brooke and Rachel plot to steal an exam and Deb escapes rehab.

s04e12.description: Prom approaches as Nathan scrambles for money, Brooke distances herself from Rachel over Chase and Deb's addiction leads to another dangerous decision.

s04e13.description: A class assignment pairs students unexpectedly and draws out private ambitions and fears, while Nathan, Skills, Brooke and Chase confront consequences of recent choices.

s04e14.description: Haley confronts Brooke about the stolen exam, Lucas and Peyton deepen their relationship and a party at the Scott house exposes a damaging recording from Nathan's past.

s04e15.description: Prom night is overshadowed by the fallout from Nathan's past, Rachel's suspension and Peyton's refusal to attend, leaving several relationships under strain.

s04e16.description: Prom turns dangerous for Peyton while Lucas closes in on the witness to Keith's murder and Nathan and Haley try to reclaim one ordinary teenage night.

s04e17.description: The group takes a road trip to bring Mouth home, giving Nathan and Haley a second prom and Lucas and Peyton time to move their relationship forward.

s04e18.description: Nathan's point-shaving scandal threatens his future while Lucas finally reaches the witness to Keith's murder and Brooke begins repairing her friendship with Peyton.

s04e19.description: Nathan and Haley face the basketball scandal together, Peyton weighs an opportunity away from Tree Hill and Lucas tells Karen the truth about Dan.

s04e20.description: Graduation arrives as Haley prepares for motherhood, Nathan faces life without basketball, Brooke risks her future with a confession and Karen's pregnancy turns critical.

s04e21.description: The seniors leave high school behind as Karen and Haley give birth, Dan faces the consequences of killing Keith and the group chooses paths beyond Tree Hill.
